verdict.rationale: Cline documents explicit background-automation capabilities: headless CLI mode for scripts/CI/CD, autonomous execution without prompts, cron-based scheduling via a hub, and running headlessly in GitHub Actions/GitLab pipelines or chat platforms. This directly matches the story of autonomous background automations. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the cron scheduling and pipeline automation actually working reliably in practice, beyond first-party docs.
